newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT cellphone unit says to cut monthly rates.
newsitem.headline: NTT cellphone unit says to cut monthly rates.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's (NTT) cellular phone unit said on Thursday that it plans to cut basic monthly charges on its cellphone service by up to 18 percent from June 1.

The unit, NTT Mobile Communications Network Inc (NTT Docomo), said the basic monthly rates for its digital service, which is one of its most popular cell-phone services, would fall 18 percent to 4,900 yen.
The tariff cuts would reduce Docomo's revenues by 30 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, a company spokesman said.
NTT Docomo has a nearly 50 percent share of Japan's cellular phone market.
